title: RCL Draw Test
description: An interactive MicroSim for testing the uniformity of drawResistor, drawInductor, and drawCapacitor functions from the p5-circuit-lib.js library.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the schematic symbols for a resistor, inductor, and capacitor by their zig-zag, coil, and parallel-plate forms
Explain how a shared parameter signature of x, y, width, height, lineWidth, orientation, label, and labelPosition makes the three drawing functions uniform
Compare horizontal and vertical component orientations and the four label positions of top, bottom, left, and right
Trace the required script load order in which p5.js supplies TOP and LEFT, p5-circuit-lib.js supplies HORIZONTAL and VERTICAL, and the sketch consumes both
Evaluate whether all three components scale uniformly when the size slider varies from 0.5x to 2.0x
